# Working on this repo This is IWP: one personal cashflow app, one `index.html` (~145 KB) with all HTML, CSS and JavaScript inside it. No build step, no framework, no package manager. Plain ES5-style JavaScript in one IIFE. Edit the file, upload it, done. It tracks real money â€” private loans, land leases and trade rounds, in Myanmar kyat. Wrong numbers are worse than no numbers. ## Rules that will break the app if ignored 1. **Never rename the storage key.** It is `iwp_v4`. The app reads the user's whole book from that key. Rename it and the app opens empty while the real data sits untouched under the old name. The same goes for `iwp_db` / `state` (IndexedDB), `iwp_fb_v1` and `iwp_mail_v1`. 2. **`APP_VER` in `index.html` and `CACHE` in `sw.js` change together.** Both must be bumped in the same commit, to the same number. The service worker only installs a new version when `sw.js` itself changes. Bump one and not the other and phones keep serving the old build for days. 3. **Never use `confirm()`, `alert()` or `prompt()`.** Browsers block them in embedded contexts and they return silently, which once made a delete button look dead. Every dialog goes through the in-app sheet (`openSheet`, `askDelete`); every form error through the inline error paragraph. 4. **New fields must be optional.** Old records saved by earlier versions will not have them. Guard every read (`+it.extra||0`, `it.moves||[]`). Never add a field that existing records must have. 5. **Do not touch the `loaded` flag.** `save()` returns early until boot has finished reading. Removing that guard lets a half-loaded empty state overwrite real data. This is the one unrecoverable bug. 6. **Derived numbers are computed, never stored.** Balances, interest, profit and totals are recalculated from the records every time. Store the inputs, never the answers. 7. **Do not change the sync shapes.** Firestore path is `users/{uid}/iwp_chunks/{core|graves|ltloan|stloan|lease|cycle}`. Records carry `S.rev[id]` (last changed) and `S.dead[id]` (tombstone). Newest wins, a delete beats an older edit, ties go to the cloud. Tombstones must persist or a device that missed a delete will resurrect the record. Changing any of this silently desynchronises the user's phone, iPad and PC. 8. **No credential forms.** Sign-in is by emailed link only. This page was once flagged by Google Safe Browsing as a phishing site; an input of type `password` on this free hosting address is part of why.
